security.item: Escaped all values shown in administrator messages (URLs, exception messages); raw API responses are no longer shown in the UI and go to the plugin log file instead (XSS fix)
Articles that guests cannot view (non-public access level or unpublished/non-public category) are never submitted to search engines
Articles with a future Start Publishing date or a past Finish Publishing date are no longer submitted
Search engine endpoint is checked against an allowlist before any request is sent
Added a 10 second timeout to the IndexNow request so a slow endpoint cannot block saving articles
Key file is never overwritten if a file with the same name but different content exists; key file is written with the Joomla Filesystem API
API key is validated when the plugin settings are saved (8-128 letters, digits or dashes, as required by the IndexNow specification)
Notification messages are shown only in the administrator; frontend, API and CLI requests no longer receive them

addition.item: Joomla 6 install script that blocks installation on Joomla older than 6.0 or PHP older than 8.3
Key file is created when the plugin settings are saved, and the file of a replaced key is removed
Noindex detection now also honours the category robots setting and the global robots setting
Multilingual sites: submitted URLs include the article language
Plugin log file administrator/logs/plg_content_pnkrindexnow.php (errors always, everything in debug mode)

change.item: Requires Joomla 6.0 or later and PHP 8.3 or later; Joomla 5 is no longer supported (use version 1.1.1)
Event handlers use the typed Joomla event classes (AfterSaveEvent, AfterChangeStateEvent, AfterDeleteEvent)
Service provider uses the Joomla 6 plugin constructor and lazy loading
HTTP client uses the Joomla Framework HttpFactory instead of the deprecated CMS HttpFactory
Batch publish/unpublish sends all URLs in a single IndexNow request instead of one request per article
URLs use https when the site forces SSL

fix.item: Changing the state of articles no longer uses the Site article model, which could throw a 404 error after the state was already saved
Update server entry uses folder/client instead of the invalid group tag, so Joomla can match updates reliably
Removed unused and duplicated language strings; clarified the debug mode and removal notification descriptions

note.item: Fixed: Error when saving articles - metadata field handling corrected to support both JSON string and Registry object formats
Added: Support for article deletion notifications
Added: Robots noindex detection to skip indexing articles marked with noindex
Improved: Security enhancements for key file creation
Added: IndexNow API integration for automatic article indexing
Added: Support for multiple search engines (IndexNow, Bing, Yahoo, Yandex)
